notes.title: Update 1.1
The release took place
notes.notes:
Dear players!
The release of the game took place!
We ask you to support us, leave your feedback about the game, and also join our Discord server!
https://discord.gg/8fMCdAf

notes.title: The release will take place
notes.notes:
Dear players!
We solved all the problems that affected the transfer of the game’s renalization, so the game will be re-cut on September 16, 2019!
Join us at Discord and make new friends!
https://discord.gg/8fMCdAf

notes.title: The release is postponed
notes.notes:
Dear players!
The release of the game was scheduled for September 16, 2019. But due to some difficulties, we are forced to postpone the release to October 1, 2019.
To pass the waiting time, you can go to our Discord server and meet new players, as well as make new friends!
Join us!
https://discord.gg/8fMCdAf

notes.title: Discord server
notes.notes:
Dear players!
The release of the game is approaching. Recent tests are in full swing. In the meantime, to pass the wait, you can visit our Discord channel and chat with other players!
https://discord.gg/8fMCdAf
